content.title: Multidisciplinary interventions recommended for the management of chronic heart failure
content.summary: Clinical trials include complex, bundled interventions; table presents characteristics and components important for HF management programmes (HF-MP). Multidisciplinary HF management and self-management reduce HF hospitalization and mortality. Home-based and/or clinic-based programmes improve outcomes. Influenza and pneumococcal vaccination considered to prevent HF hospitalizations.

recommendations.text: It is recommended that HF patients are enrolled in a multidisciplinary HF management programme to reduce the risk of HF hospitalization and mortality.
Self-management strategies are recommended to reduce the risk of HF hospitalization and mortality.
Either home-based and/or clinic-based programmes improve outcomes and are recommended to reduce the risk of HF hospitalization and mortality.
Influenza and pneumococcal vaccinations should be considered in order to prevent HF hospitalizations.

notes: Footnote: a = Class of recommendation. HF = heart failure.
